Physicist working on machine learning and computational biology. This site is a public research notebook for problems in biological inference, with a particular focus on cell-state representation, perturbation biology, and single-cell genomics.

## Current project

### Virtual Cell Challenge 2026

I am using the challenge as a test bed for simple statistical baselines, perturbation models, and new ideas about how cellular responses generalise across context.

[Follow the Virtual Cell series →](virtual-cell/index.qmd)

## Recurring questions

Beyond the current programme, I return to questions about what biological measurements let us infer: noise, contamination, identifiability, scaling, high-dimensional inference, and the statistical assumptions hidden inside common pipelines.

[Explore the threads →](threads/index.qmd)
